reason: Thirty-six dollars for a lip balm is a lot when my drugstore balm does the job, and I wouldn't give a gift from a brand nobody has reviewed yet. If it turned out to be bad, I'd look silly in front of my sister.
objection: It's a tinted balm with no reviews from a company I've never heard of, at the price of a nice department-store lipstick. I can't tell whether it's any better than a $5 tinted balm.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews from women my age saying it doesn't dry out or feather, or a friend telling me she loves hers.
